query:
insert into ConflictingCollectedFiles (
                        latest_collection,
                        filepath,
                        file_hash
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        filepath,
                        file_hash
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
